scope: CPU bookkeeping audit repair only; execution code/data and scientific tolerances unchanged
diagnosis: Difference of separately FP32-reduced coefficient sums need not equal a separate FP32 reduction of per-row differences; the former audit used the near-zero signed result as its relative scale.
replacement: Analytic FP32 reduction identity bound using u=2^-24, gamma_(n+1)/(1-gamma_(n+1))*(abs(sum_a)+abs(sum_b)+sum_abs_delta), where n is the retained occurrence count; not a change to per-block mass/bounds checks.
